These 28 named state assemblies qualify as components of state legislatures; a legislative council, where present, is another chamber and requires its own service checks. Union territories are assessed under their separate legal bases. This settles the constitutional scope gate, not current assembly membership, adjournment, dissolution or President’s Rule. Confirm current institutional activity before describing a recording as a current/live sitting, particularly Manipur. Municipal councils remain outside scope.

checked_sources.title: Authority completion: czech-higher-territorial-assemblies
checked_sources.note: Constitution Article 104 distinguishes higher territorial self-government and gives its assemblies generally binding ordinances. The Regions Act 129/2000 separates independent regional legislation from delegated state administration and reserves ordinances and budget to the elected assembly. These regional assemblies meet the substantive regional-ordinance rule. Prague qualifies in its combined regional capacity under Act 131/2000, not every municipal council. The ministry’s English Regions Act is a historical translation, read for the independent/delegated distinction with the constitutional and governmental explanations; not a certification of every current procedural amendment.

checked_sources.note: Constitution Article 104 distinguishes higher territorial self-government and gives its assemblies generally binding ordinances. The Regions Act 129/2000 separates independent regional legislation from delegated state administration and reserves ordinances and budget to the elected assembly. These regional assemblies meet the substantive regional-ordinance rule. Prague qualifies in its combined regional capacity under Act 131/2000, not every municipal council. The ministry’s English Regions Act is a historical translation, read for the independent/delegated distinction with the constitutional and governmental explanations; not a certification of every current procedural amendment.

checked_sources.title: Authority completion: tobago-bill-proposal-and-administration
checked_sources.note: The Tobago House of Assembly Act section 29 allows proposing/adopting Bills but requires Cabinet introduction and national Parliament enactment for an Assembly Law. Its own votes do not enact those laws. Its substantial devolved administration, budget and scrutiny therefore do not establish autonomous territorial lawmaking under the present catalogue rule. The Assembly-hosted base text is consolidated only to 2013. Act 1/2026 was read and changes secretary numbers/quorum, not section 29’s enactment route. This exclusion is a project scope interpretation despite its Legislature branding; reopen on enacted substantive autonomy powers, not a proposed reform.

checked_sources.title: Authority completion: indonesian-provincial-representative-legislation
checked_sources.note: Constitution Article 18(3), (5) and (6) establishes elected regional representative councils and autonomous regional regulations. Regional Government Act 23/2014 Articles 96–101 gives provincial DPRDs regional regulation-making, budget and oversight functions. These provincial legislatures pass the regional-ordinance scope gate, rather than merely administering assigned services. Article 18B preserves special/autonomous arrangements. Aceh qanun/DPRA, Yogyakarta privileges, Jakarta’s transitional name/status and the Papuan DPRP/DPRK/MRP distinctions require exact institution and event identification before any viewing-service addition. An MRP cultural consultative council or a national DPR hearing about a province is not its provincial legislature. The base Act is used for structural powers, not as a complete current consolidation of each special statute.

checked_sources.note: Constitution Article 18(3), (5) and (6) establishes elected regional representative councils and autonomous regional regulations. Aceh qanun/DPRA, Yogyakarta privileges, Jakarta’s transitional name/status and the Papuan DPRP/DPRK/MRP distinctions require exact institution and event identification before any viewing-service addition. An MRP cultural consultative council or a national DPR hearing about a province is not its provincial legislature. The base Act is used for structural powers, not as a complete current consolidation of each special statute.

Regional Government Act 23/2014 Articles 96–101 gives provincial DPRDs regional regulation-making, budget and oversight functions. These provincial legislatures pass the regional-ordinance scope gate, rather than merely administering assigned services. Article 18B preserves special/autonomous arrangements. Aceh qanun/DPRA, Yogyakarta privileges, Jakarta’s transitional name/status and the Papuan DPRP/DPRK/MRP distinctions require exact institution and event identification before any viewing-service addition. An MRP cultural consultative council or a national DPR hearing about a province is not its provincial legislature. The base Act is used for structural powers, not as a complete current consolidation of each special statute.
